{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''individual''' who belonged to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] once carried the [[Relle Talisman]], an [[Sith talisman/Legends|artifact]] created by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] [[Zoiya Relle]] that granted its wielder the ability to dominate the [[Brain/Legends|minds]] of other individuals. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was thought that the Sith carrying the talisman had [[Death/Legends|perished]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
